predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: the Ye land, reorganized into Lintun Commandery in 108 BCE and independent in 82 BCE

successors.name: Goguryeo
successors.text: the Ye land, annexed by Gwanggaeto

ledger.x: 82 BCE: the Ye become independent of Han as Lintun is abolished.

wars.name: Ye attacks on the southern neighbours (AD 40 and AD 60)
wars.outcome: Raids with no territorial result on the page.

wars.name: Goguryeo's subjugation of the Okjeo and Dongye (reign of Taejo)
wars.outcome: Goguryeo made the Okjeo tributary and took the Ye as a vassal; the sentences are undated.

wars.name: Goguryeo's annexation of Ye under Gwanggaeto
wars.outcome: Goguryeo annexed the Ye; the page puts it in the early 5th century and adds that a small southern part was absorbed into Silla.

certainty.note: A chiefdom confederation on the east coast with no treaty or survey line on any page; the Cliopatria outline is a core of the three modern provinces the page names.
